title: Government Assistance—No Specific Relation to Operating Activities
summary: Addresses government assistance that does not relate to specific operating activities, confirming it remains a government grant under IAS 20 and should be recognised in profit or loss on a systematic basis.

related.title: Accounting for Government Grants and Disclosure of Government Assistance
related.relationship: The parent standard SIC-10 confirms applies to assistance not tied to specific operating activities

related.title: Agriculture
related.relationship: Government grants related to biological assets measured at fair value less costs to sell have a distinct treatment, outside SIC-10's general scope

related.title: Financial Instruments: Presentation
related.relationship: Supplies the equity/liability distinction relevant to distinguishing genuine capital contributions from grants
